name: zoom-words
title: Zoom Words
description: Huge words fade into a long line while the camera rides the write head.
useWhen: An intro should open uncomfortably close: huge words appear one by one while the camera tracks the growing line off-frame.
The shot starts slightly defocused and sharpens while the reveal runs.
avoidWhen: The whole phrase must fit the frame at rest: use per-word-crossfade or word-stream.
You need character-by-character typing with a caret: use typewriter.
author: Remocn
